title: Bound for Dependent Impossible Differentials in Feistel Structures
summary: A bound is known for independent impossible differentials; it remains conjectured that the same bound also covers dependent and hence all such differentials in these Feistel structures.

formal_statement.body: For Feistel structures with SP-type round functions, the bound $2R_2(P)+5$ applies to independent impossible differentials, while dependent impossible differentials may also exist. The unresolved conjecture is whether the same bound $2R_2(P)+5$ applies to dependent and therefore to all impossible differentials of these structures.

scope.domain: Structural cryptanalysis of Feistel structures with SP-type round functions using impossible differentials.
parameters: R_2(P), the quantity appearing in the stated bound
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the bound 2R_2(P)+5 applies to dependent and therefore all impossible differentials of these structures.

citations.label: Provable Security Evaluation of Structures Against Impossible Differential and Zero Correlation Linear Cryptanalysis

progress.summary: The source states that the bound 2R_2(P)+5 applies to independent impossible differentials and acknowledges that dependent ones may exist. It presents the authors' belief that the same bound applies to all impossible differentials as an unresolved conjecture.
citation_labels: Bing Sun et al., Provable Security Evaluation of Structures Against Impossible Differential and Zero Correlation Linear Cryptanalysis
